violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Paper towels available for replacement at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

Several food items on the hot hold line were observed held at 122-125 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items were properly reheated at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

Frozen Chicken was observed thawing in a bowl with standing water in the prep sink. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Water was turned on and allowed to flow over the submerged product at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

Dessert items repackaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients and allergens, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Per the PIC, all necessary label information is available on original packaging and to be made into labels for individual containers. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
